blockers.detail: AfterShip 5.25.8 content is an APKM with an .apk suffix; the real Python CLI failed all 12 Morphe cases with manifest-null errors. The observation is retained as a negative control and planned native parity case. The positive timed workload uses a byte-identical .apkm copy; no production compatibility behavior was changed or normalized away.

One timed default-jobs sample failed a single Morphe case with 'Failed to find end record' inside Morphe's archive reader while two default-jobs reruns passed 12/12. The baseline workflows run Morphe with --jobs 1, which keeps every case, is deterministic, and reproduced identical prepared output hashes. The failed sample is retained in the ignored private baseline as evidence.
